rowFilters.component: If Exist in DB and Not Exists In File
rowFilters.output: beneficiary does not exists in a file

rowFilters.expression: anti-join key: a CRM beneficiary reaches the delete writers only if no valid file row has the same (bank account, beneficiary ID, fund type) — Merge Join NumKeyColumns=3, then ISNULL(ExistsInFile). WHICH OUTCOME HAPPENS IS UNRESOLVED: JoinType=1 (LEFT outer); Sort 2 (file side, ExistsInFile = literal 1) feeds the input NAMED "Merge Join Left Input", but the <input> elements are serialized Right-then-Left (DTSX 85213 Right, 85222 Left — the only such Merge Join of 10). (a) if left = the named Left input → ExistsInFile never NULL → nothing deleted; (b) if left = the first serialized input (CRM side) → every active CRM beneficiary without a matching valid file row is deleted each run. Needs SSDT check or production counters (Row Deleted Count) (Merge Join DTSX 85205-85207 (JoinType 1, NumKeyColumns 3), inputs DTSX 85213/85222, output ExistsInFile ← Left input (DTSX 85235), split DTSX 85012, Add additional Columns DTSX 79661)
second Merge Join key (trimmed ID); outcome unresolved as above (DTSX 85205-85290)
third Merge Join key (trimmed, "5006" → "1025" by 'Convert funtTypeId to CRM value'); outcome unresolved as above (DTSX 80484, 85205-85290)
defines the "valid" file rows on the file side of the anti-join: rows with Subject_12 != "01" are dropped before the Merge Join, so they do not protect a CRM beneficiary (DTSX 85144)
file rows with NULL or 0 division percent are dropped before the Merge Join (DTSX 85144)
file rows with a non-NULL type != "1" are dropped before the Merge Join (DTSX 85144)
file rows with (DT_I4)License_Type_57 != 1 are dropped before the Merge Join (DTSX 85144)

targets.recordKey: Row.Genbeneficiariesid — Gen_beneficiariesid read from CRM by 'Get Beneficiaries from DB' (active gen_beneficiaries + customer account bank number + account type gen_id; SQL with JOINs, DTSX 84966) via Sort 1 → Merge Join right input. Not listed in recordKeyColumns: the lineage tool marks this CRM SQL projection as an OPEN sql-expression; it carries no file value
targets.writeCondition: CRM active beneficiary ('Get Beneficiaries from DB') whose (bank account, ID, account type) has no valid file row ('Is Valid  Beneficiary' DTSX 85144: Subject_12 == "01", Devision_Percent_26 non-NULL/≠0, Account_Owner_Identifiaction_Type_7 NULL or "1", ID non-blank, License_Type_57 == 1). UNRESOLVED whether this ever fires: the CRM side is wired to the input named "Merge Join Right Input" but serialized first (DTSX 85213/85222) with JoinType=1 — either (a) no row ever reaches the writers, or (b) every such beneficiary is deleted each run. Not provable from the DTSX; needs SSDT check or production counters

rowFilterOf.component: Package\Delete Beneficiaries\Delete Beneficiaries
rowFilterOf.expression: anti-join key: a CRM beneficiary reaches the delete writers only if no valid file row has the same (bank account, beneficiary ID, fund type) — Merge Join NumKeyColumns=3, then ISNULL(ExistsInFile). WHICH OUTCOME HAPPENS IS UNRESOLVED: JoinType=1 (LEFT outer); Sort 2 (file side, ExistsInFile = literal 1) feeds the input NAMED "Merge Join Left Input", but the <input> elements are serialized Right-then-Left (DTSX 85213 Right, 85222 Left — the only such Merge Join of 10). (a) if left = the named Left input → ExistsInFile never NULL → nothing deleted; (b) if left = the first serialized input (CRM side) → every active CRM beneficiary without a matching valid file row is deleted each run. Needs SSDT check or production counters (Row Deleted Count) (Merge Join DTSX 85205-85207 (JoinType 1, NumKeyColumns 3), inputs DTSX 85213/85222, output ExistsInFile ← Left input (DTSX 85235), split DTSX 85012, Add additional Columns DTSX 79661)

notes.note: FINDING 1 (UNRESOLVED, two possible outcomes) — Delete Beneficiaries: Merge Join (DTSX 85205) has JoinType=1 (LEFT outer); the file rows (Sort 2, ExistsInFile = literal 1) feed the input NAMED "Merge Join Left Input" and CRM beneficiaries the one named "Right", but the <input> elements are serialized Right-then-Left (DTSX 85213/85222; the only Merge Join of 10 with this order). (a) If SSIS takes "left" by name → ExistsInFile is never NULL and nothing is ever deleted. (b) If it takes "left" by position → every active CRM beneficiary without a matching valid file row (Is Valid  Beneficiary DTSX 85144) is deleted on each run. Not provable from the DTSX — confirm in SSDT or from production counters (Row Deleted Count / ETL process counters).

Create Contact link: possible duplicate gen_contactlink rows in the same run — Aggregate groups on 17 columns and nothing de-duplicates (parent, child, customer account) before the full-cache 'Is ContactLink Exists' lookup.

Create Warning Note: Aggregate (DTSX 69294) also groups on FinanceNumber_11 and Account_Owner_Id_8, which are unused downstream → file rows differing only in those fields create duplicate warning notes in one run.

FINDING 2 — new parent contacts are never linked in the same run: 'Check If Contact Is Duplicate' sends only the first row per parent ID to NeedToCreate, drops later duplicates (no DirectRowTo) and sends only NULL-ID rows to NotNeedToCreate; IDs are never NULL after 'Add 0' padding, so the inner Merge Join (Sort ⋈ created contacts on gen_Parentidentitynumber_9) gets no left rows. Create Contact link / Update ContactLink therefore only receive parents that already existed in CRM (is Parent Exist match); a link for a newly created parent appears only in a later run — and 'Disabled contactlink' then sets gen_status = 2 on links not re-confirmed.

FINDING 3 — Update Contact writes the CHILD's identification type onto the PARENT: Param_11 gen_identificationtype comes from lookup 'Is Child Exists' (child contact) and is replaced by Type_20 only when the child's value is NULL (compare befor update main.cs:154-158; the "== 10" alternative is unreachable).

Update Employee MobilePhone: when the composed phone is empty and CRM has a phone, the CRM phone is cleared; modifiedon is written with DateTime.Now (local) into Gen_customeraccountBase (UTC column). Phone = Division_60 (prefix) + Workplace_59 (number) for Subject_12 == "11" rows; staging aliases Phone_Prefix/Phone_Number proven by externalMetadataColumnId (DTSX 103106-103107).

Customer account at-risk dates are passed as culture-dependent strings (DateTime.ToString()) into datetime columns; 'Need To Update' can never send a routed row to NoNeedToUpdate because each Check-If-To-Update branch implies a flag change (main.cs:50).

Contact names: Create/Update Contact take lastname from file Beneficiary_Name_51 and firstname from Lawyer_Name_52 (staging aliases ParentLastName/ParentFirstName, DTSX 40990-41013) and fullname from Full_Name_23; Update Contact also writes FullName directly by SQL.

Dates: Beneficiaries flow converts dates local→UTC→local (net no change); contactlink skips UTC conversion for gen_Parentbirthdate but Create path still applies ToLocalTime() (time part = offset), Update path writes the local date raw into ContactBase; Instruction provision writes UTC values.

Convert PL: duplicate branch value == 5945 → 9 (Accountant) is dead code; values not covered by the mapping stay NULL (authentication/permit type) or 0→NULL (role/type). Lookup 'Is Instruction provision exist' never matches when a map value is NULL, so such rows are always INSERTed (possible duplicates).
Warning note types: set vanila fields 1 caches NewId by code only (not code+subject), so a second new subject with the same code reuses the first row's type id and no type is created for it.
